definition: William Aaron Woods (born June 17, 1942), generally known as Bill Woods, is a researcher in natural language processing, continuous speech understanding, knowledge representation, and knowledge-based search technology.
details: He is currently a Software Engineer at Google.
story: Imagine learning a language by reading every book in the library and noticing, over time, which words travel together. It does not memorize a rulebook; it absorbs a library. The machine learns language the way you did — by hearing so much of it that the patterns sink in. It is fluency built from pattern, not from memorized rules. And that is William Aaron Woods — teaching a machine to read between the lines.
